summary: Empirical issue-tracking research supports structured, complete intake and shows associations with better handling. It does not establish that an autonomous LLM proxy improves outcomes; that part requires local comparison against human triage.

items.text: Zhang et al. (2024) analyzed bug-report templates across 3,194 GitHub projects and associated templates with fewer comments overall and a greater likelihood of reports being addressed; the observational design does not prove causality or show that every removed comment was clarification.
Bettenburg et al., What Makes a Good Bug Report? (2008), combined repository analysis with developer surveys and found reproducibility information, stack traces and test cases especially useful.

A 2022 systematic mapping study of requirements-quality research catalogs ambiguity, incompleteness and inconsistency as recurring concerns; it offers adjacent evidence for normalization rules rather than a trial of AI intake proxies.
